arStrings.szText: A historian at the Temple of Life arranged for the transport of a Firstborn artifact, but the ship carrying it is mysteriously overdue.
Drollon's shipment never arrived. I should go with him to check the shoreline for any sign of it.

Drollon is a scholar who studies ancient relics of the firstborn. His most recent shipment, a Tear of the Firstborn, has yet to arrive. I should accompany him to the shoreline to find out what happened.
The ship carrying Drollon's shipment has run aground. We should use the dinghy on the shore to travel to it.
The only souls left on this ship are the souls of the dead. I should investigate with Drollon to figure out what happened.
